description: Continuous transform (free on Basic): 1-minute log counts per service x template x level. All anomaly rules read this small index, never the raw TB/day indices. The dest name must NOT match the source patterns (logs-* would include itself). missing_bucket keeps lines without service.name, or with a log.template over the keyword ignore_above (1024), instead of silently dropping them. Events arriving later than sync.time.delay are not counted; raise delay or sync on an ingest-timestamp field.
